timeline.text: Before an interview, the app lived in a browser tab — one bad reload and it was gone.
On iPhone there's no install button at all, so most people just kept a bookmark and lost it.
Now it installs like any other app, icon and all, right on the home screen.
A service worker caches the shell, so a flaky connection shows the app, not a blank white page.
One tap opens it, ready, on Android and iPhone alike.
